opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant – under £100,000. Grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; capital grants for local community projects no greater than £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous decision.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, and projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Supports charities working in arts, community, education, environment, faith, health, museums and heritage, welfare, and youth.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million (regardless of annual income). Must be a UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation with at least one year's accounts. Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply for a regular grant instead.
opportunities.summary: Grants of £100,000 and over considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines. Expressions of Interest reviewed on a rolling basis.
